summary: Recent changes to the Web Speech feature in Firefox enhance its reliability and performance during audio interruptions. The browser now effectively **prevents self-start of Web Speech when audio sessions are disrupted**, ensuring that users won't accidentally trigger speech recognition during other audio playback. Additionally, improvements in managing the lifecycles of Web Speech and Web Audio allow seamless suspension and resumption of these features when there's an audio-focus change, meaning users will enjoy a smoother experience when switching between different audio applications. These updates are crucial as they contribute to a more coherent and user-friendly interaction in voice-driven applications and services.
